scope: read-only comparison on the one already selected mesh; useful even if predictor ordering blocks all evolution. Does not admit static/physical continuation or claim spatial order.
inputs: actual stored initial coefficients and fixed reference; corrected no-factor nativeG/D/freeM and pressure physical masses/constants; same continuous physical input and native signed analytic-versus-represented loads
loads: inner volume linear_shear plus molecular_shear represented-minus-continuous
action: Pi=-[D Mfree^-1 G]^-1 D Mfree^-1 r; actual C0/unused-gauge exclusion checked; no predictor factor needed, no dense Schur or M^-1G columns
norm: exact native physical P2 pressure mass on the identical flat physical domain,whole/inner/outer signed mean,RMS and variation. Full fine modes retained. Magnitudes/alignments compared,not coefficient positions or a formal rate; not a common-test convergence certificate.

checks.governing_quadrature: unchanged native32/8/12/12/64; no evolved spatial qualification from this static diagnostic

stopping: one immutable comparison only; stop on domain/row/solve/memory failure; no extra mesh,time-step or physical solve
interpretation: report whether initial shear pressure image decreases beyond numerical uncertainty. Actual Pi time-step uncertainty and interface margin require the separately gated physical pair; no surrogate admission.
comparison: information only: ratio<1 is an observed magnitude decrease; resolved reduction additionally requires baseline-selected RMS > max(1e-8,10 times the sum of both scaled physical repeat upper bounds). No admission or convergence order follows.
repeat_bound: 10 times maximum pressure coefficient difference/u_tau^2 bounds physical values for the9 Modified_A P2 local tensor functions (each<=1); exact native pressure masses include all fine modes.
